description: Rename a price list, change its percentOff (-1000 to 99.99, 2 decimals, negative = a markup; it prices every product the list holds no fixed price for) its startsAt / endsAt window (null clears a bound), or the sales channels it is published to (channels replaces the whole set, [] unpublishes it from every channel, leave it out to keep). Fixed prices are changed with set_price_list_entry / set_price_list_entries. Carts already priced from the list keep their prices until the buyer adds again; orders keep theirs.

channels.description: Keys of the sales channels to publish the list to (from list_sales_channels), at most 20. A channel takes one undated base list plus dated lists whose windows do not overlap; a clash is refused (CHANNEL_BASE_TAKEN or CHANNEL_WINDOW_OVERLAP). Anyone can read the prices of a list published to a PUBLIC channel.

endsAt.description: ISO date-time the list stops pricing buyers at, later than startsAt. null clears it (no end); leave it out to keep it. Outside its window a list prices nobody: its buyers pay catalogue prices.

percentOff.description: Percent taken off the catalogue price (and every volume break) of each product the list holds no fixed price for: -1000 to 99.99, at most two decimals (12.5 = 12.5% off). A negative value is a markup above the catalogue (-10 = 10% more). 0 = the list prices only through its fixed prices.

startsAt.description: ISO date-time the list starts pricing buyers from. null clears it (priced from now on); leave it out to keep it.
